policy: Use existing local materials first. Import a candidate only after a specific level/skill/context gap, source rights, content, audio and answer quality are checked. A link never proves lesson completion or band readiness.

sources.title: VOA Let's Learn English Level 1
sources.use: Beginner real-speaker situations linking listening, speaking, vocabulary and writing; source describes a 52-week beginner course, not an IELTS band-7 pathway.
sources.rights: VOA-exclusive text/audio/video is public domain with credit; third-party media and AP content are excluded. Check each selected asset's origin. Do not apply the statement to all page images or music.
sources.reviewed: Official course overview and rights statement; individual lessons and media files are not yet validated.

sources.title: VOA Let's Learn English Level 2
sources.use: Intermediate contextual input candidate; no CEFR or IELTS equivalence inferred from the title.
sources.reviewed: Official search result only; page and selected assets need full review.
sources.rights: Same asset-specific VOA/third-party distinction; no media imported.

sources.title: British Council graded grammar
sources.use: Reference for confirmed grammar prerequisite gaps, especially form/meaning/use contrasts; create independent practice only after checking an appropriate point.
sources.rights: Link/reference only; no permission for bulk copying inferred.
sources.reviewed: Official category and A1-A2 section verified; individual tasks not imported.

sources.title: Cambridge IELTS preparation
sources.use: Official sample task references; archive contents have not been downloaded or checked. Not assumed to contain book-specific listening audio.
sources.rights: Official sample access does not imply unrestricted republication.

sources.title: Cambridge IELTS 19 companion resources
sources.use: Publisher states the product includes listening audio and resource bank; local PDFs do not include these files. Book 19 remains reserved, not vocabulary pre-teaching input.
sources.rights: Follow publisher access mechanism; no public companion audio URL or authorization bypass assumed.
sources.reviewed: Official product page only; audio files not accessed.

sources.title: OpenStax College Success
sources.use: Academic-life topic source candidate for confirmed reading/vocabulary gaps; level requires adaptation and review, not assumed beginner-safe.
sources.rights: This title's official preface states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Any derivative must retain attribution and the same content license and noncommercial restriction; do not apply a blanket CC BY assumption or copy unrelated artwork.
sources.reviewed: Specific title license verified; no chapters or images imported.
